<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px">因为工作需要经常切网络查看我的IP地址，每次都是请求如https://iplark.com/查看，想这种经常要用的不如自己做个插件，于是自己动手使用Gemini3开发功能，ui-ux-pro-max skill设计页面完成了如下插件，名字叫：myIp pro，与对话过程如下</span></h1>
<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1234647/202602/1234647-20260226094801981-264019688.png" alt="image"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1234647/202602/1234647-20260226094818004-12896915.png" alt="image"></span></h1>
<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus">&nbsp;</h1>
<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">Chat Conversation</span></h1>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Note: </span><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">This is purely the output of the chat conversation and does not contain any raw data, codebase snippets, etc. used to generate the output.</span></em></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">我现在想开发个chrome插件，具体功能就是右上角有个图标，然后点击这个图标就能显示我的当前ip地址，还有ip归属地是哪里，风格使用/ui-ux-pro-max </span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">*Listed directory </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">myIp</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> *</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Implementation Plan - MyIP Chrome Extension</span></h1>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">开发一个高颜值的 Chrome 插件，用于实时显示用户的 IP 地址及其地理位置信息。</span></p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1. 技术栈与设计风格</span></h2>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">核心</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: HTML5, CSS3 (Vanilla), JavaScript (ES6+)。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">规范</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: Chrome Extension Manifest V3。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">UI 风格</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>/ui-ux-pro-max</code></span><span class="md-plain"> (极简主义、玻璃拟态 Glassmorphism、丝滑动画、深色模式优先)。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">API</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 使用主流且稳定的 IP 地理位置 API（如 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ipapi.co</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 或 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ip-api.com</code></span><span class="md-plain">）。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2. 文件结构</span></h2>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>manifest.json</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 插件配置文件。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>popup.html</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 弹出层结构。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>popup.css</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 核心视觉样式，包含高级动效和渐变。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>popup.js</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 业务逻辑，负责抓取数据并更新 UI。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>icons/</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 包含不同尺寸的图标（16x16, 48x48, 128x128）。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3. 任务清单</span></h2>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item task-list-item  md-task-list-item task-list-not-done "><input type="checkbox"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">初始化项目</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 创建基础目录结构。</span></li>
<li class="md-list-item task-list-item  md-task-list-item task-list-not-done "><input type="checkbox"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">编写 Manifest</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 配置权限和弹出窗口。</span></li>
<li class="md-list-item task-list-item  md-task-list-item task-list-not-done "><input type="checkbox"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">UI 界面开发</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: </span>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">实现玻璃拟态背景。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">添加加载动画。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">设计响应布局。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item task-list-item  md-task-list-item task-list-not-done "><input type="checkbox"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">功能逻辑实现</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">:</span>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">调用 API 获取 IP 数据。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">处理数据并渲染到界面。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">增加“点击复制”功能。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item task-list-item  md-task-list-item task-list-not-done "><input type="checkbox"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">美化与优化</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">:</span>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">添加微交互效果（Hover, Active）。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">确保在不同缩放下的兼容性。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">4.Thought 思考过程</span></h2>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">设计感</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 插件图标必须精致，弹出窗口不能是死板的白色块。我们将使用深蓝/紫色的渐变背景，配合半透明模糊效果，营造高端科技感。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">用户体验</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 考虑到网络延迟，进入时会显示一个优雅的 Skeleton Loading（骨架屏）或 Spinner。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">性能</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 所有的逻辑都在 Popup 开启时即时抓取，不占用持续的后台资源。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block" tabindex="-1"><hr></div>

<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">注意事项：</span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">图标</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 目前 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">manifest.json</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> 中引用了 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>icons/</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 文件夹下的图标。由于图片生成失败，您需要在该目录下创建一个 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>icons</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 文件夹，并放入名为 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>icon16.png</code></span><span class="md-plain">, </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>icon48.png</code></span><span class="md-plain">, </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>icon128.png</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 的图片，否则浏览器会报错找不到图标。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">功能</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 点击插件图标后，它会自动调用 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ipapi.co</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 的接口获取您的 IP 和位置。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>

<div class="md-hr md-end-block" tabindex="-1"><hr></div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">Implementation Plan (Summary)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">:</span></p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Created </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">manifest.json</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> with V3 spec.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Created </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.html</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> with premium Glassmorphism structure.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Created </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.css</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> with radial gradients, blur effects, and animations.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Created </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.js</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> with </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">fetch</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> logic for IP and local time update.</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">您现在可以去浏览器加载试用了！如果有任何样式或功能上的调整需求，请随时告诉我。</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">icon16.png, icon48.png, icon128.png 的图片有什么要求</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">对于 Chrome 插件图标，有几个核心的技术要求和设计建议，以确保它们在浏览器的各个位置（菜单栏、管理页、应用商店）都能完美显示：</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1. 技术要求</span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">文件格式</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 必须是 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">PNG</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 格式（因为需要支持透明度）。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">尺寸 (必选)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">:</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>16x16</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 用于插件栏的 Favicon 或者是某些小菜单。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>48x48</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 用于 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>chrome://extensions</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 插件管理页面。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>128x128</code></span><span class="md-plain">: 用于安装时的确认弹窗以及 Chrome Web Store。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">透明背景</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 背景建议设为透明，这样在浏览器的深色或浅色主题下都能完美融合。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">正方形</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 图标比例必须是 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">1:1</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 的正方形。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2. 设计建议 (匹配 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>/ui-ux-pro-max</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 风格)</span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">间距 (Padding)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 不要让核心图形贴边。建议在边缘留出 10%~15% 的边距，避免某些圆形裁剪时切掉内容。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">颜色</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 既然我们的 UI 使用了深紫色/深蓝色渐变，图标建议也带一点这种色调，或者使用亮眼的蓝色/紫色，并带微弱的投影。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">清晰度</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>16x16</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 的图标非常小，建议设计得极其简约（比如只用一个鲜亮的点或极简的 IP 缩写），否则缩小后会看不清。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block" tabindex="-1"><hr></div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">我们可以尝试这样做：</span></h3>

<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">我现在加载进去了，然后点开图标显示ip地址获取失败，这怎么处理，需要我做些什么帮助你排查</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">显示“获取失败”通常是由以下两个原因之一引起的：</span></p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">权限缺失 (Host Permissions)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：在 Chrome 插件 Manifest V3 规范中，访问外部 API 最好在配置文件中明确声明，否则可能会被浏览器的安全政策 (CORS) 拦截。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">API 接口访问受限</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ipapi.co</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 有时会对某些网络环境或请求频率做限制。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">第一步：我来尝试修复插件权限 (Manifest 更新)</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">我需要为 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">manifest.json</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> 增加 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>host_permissions</code></span><span class="md-plain">，确保浏览器允许插件访问 IP 接口。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>

<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">第二步：如何排查 (需要您的帮助)</span></h3>

<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">*Viewed </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.js</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> *</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">从您提供的 Console 信息来看，</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">报错的仍然是旧地址 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>https://ipapi.co/json/</code></span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。这意味着虽然我已经修改了磁盘上的 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.js</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> 文件，但 Chrome 浏览器仍然运行的是旧版本的插件代码（缓存）。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">在 Chrome 插件开发中，仅仅点击插件弹窗里的“刷新”按钮是不够的，因为它只运行 JS 函数，不会重新加载文件。</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">请按照以下步骤操作以解决此问题：</span></h3>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">强制重新加载插件</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">在浏览器地址栏输入 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>chrome://extensions/</code></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">找到 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">MyIP Pro</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">点击卡片右下角的 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">圆形箭头图标 (刷新按钮)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。这是让 Chrome 重新读取您磁盘上最新文件的唯一方法。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">验证改动</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">重新打开插件弹窗。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">再次 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“检查弹出窗口”</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 查看 Console。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">如果这次报错（即使失败）里的地址变成了 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>https://ipwhois.app/json/</code></span><span class="md-plain">，就说明新代码已经跑起来了。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">为什么会这样？</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Chrome 为了性能会强缓存插件的脚本。您刚才修改了磁盘代码，但浏览器内存里还是旧的请求逻辑。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">如果点击了 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>chrome://extensions/</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 下的刷新按钮仍然不行：</span></strong></span> <span class="md-plain">您可以尝试在管理页面把插件 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“先关闭再开启”</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">，或者点击 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“移除”</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 后重新 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“加载已解压的扩展程序”</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。只要新版代码生效，CORS 问题就能迎刃而解！</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">我这个是怎么获取ip地址的，又是怎么解析地址所属城市的</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这是一个非常好的问题！这个插件的工作原理其实分为“</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">数据获取</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">”和“</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">位置匹配</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">”两个核心部分。下面我为您拆解一下技术细节：</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1. 如何获取你的 IP 地址？</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">虽然你的电脑知道自己的私有 IP（比如 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>192.168.x.x</code></span><span class="md-plain">），但它通常不知道自己在互联网上的“公网 IP”。</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">发起请求</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：插件在运行 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>fetch('https://ipwhois.app/json/')</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 时，向 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ipwhois.app</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 的服务器发送了一个 HTTP 请求。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">服务器识别</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：当请求到达服务器时，服务器就像“来电显示”一样，能通过网络数据包的头部直接看到你的</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">公网出口 IP</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">返回数据</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：服务器把识别到的这个 IP 地址封装在一个 JSON 对象里（比如 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>{"ip": "114.x.x.x", ...}</code></span><span class="md-plain">）返回给插件的 JavaScript。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2. 又是怎么知道城市归属地的？</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">服务器获取到你的 IP 后，并不是靠“猜”，而是靠查询一个庞大的 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">GeoIP 数据库</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">IP 分配逻辑</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：全球的 IP 地址是由 IANA（互联网号码分配局）统一管理的，并分配给各个国家和运营商（如中国电信、联通等）。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">地理位置数据库</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：像 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ipwhois.app</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 这样的服务商维护着一个极其复杂的映射表。这个表记录了：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>114.240.0.0</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 到 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>114.255.255.255</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 这一段 IP 属于</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">中国-北京-朝阳区-中国联通</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">数据来源</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：这些数据的准确性来自于：</span></p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">BGP 广播路由信息</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：观察 IP 段是在哪个物理节点被宣告的。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">WHOIS 注册信息</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：电信运营商在注册 IP 段时填写的物理地址。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">延迟侧速</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：通过从不同城市的服务器 ping 你的 IP，根据响应时间推算你大致的地理位置。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3. 为什么不直接在本地解析？</span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">体积巨大</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：完整的全球 IP 归属地数据库有几百 MB 甚至几个 GB，如果塞进插件里，插件会变得非常臃肿。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">更新频繁</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：IP 归属地经常变动（比如运营商调整路由），放在远程服务器上可以保证你每次查到的都是最新的数据。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">插件里的代码逻辑逻辑：</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">在你的 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.js</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> 中，这部分逻辑是这样实现的：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="javascript" spellcheck="false"><code>// 1. 发起请求：向服务器询问“我是谁，我在哪”
const response = await fetch('https://ipwhois.app/json/');
​
// 2. 得到回复：服务器告诉插件 IP 是 xxx，城市是 yyy
const data = await response.json();
​
// 3. 渲染界面：把数据写到 HTML 的标签里显示给你看
ipText.textContent = data.ip; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 显示 IP
city.textContent = data.city; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 显示城市</code></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">总结</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：插件本身不具备定位能力，它更像是一个“传声筒”，通过访问一个拥有全球地理信息情报库的专业服务器，来换取你当前的定位信息。</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">简单点回答，用通俗语言；另外这个方式稳定么</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">通俗解释（像“照镜子+查地图”）</span></h3>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">照镜子（获取 IP）</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span> <span class="md-plain">IP 地址就像你的“网络长相”。你自己在家里看不见自己的脸，但当你去访问远处的服务器（接口）时，服务器能清晰地看到你的“脸”（公网 IP）。它把看到的 IP 写在小纸条上回传给你。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">查地图（解析城市）</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span> <span class="md-plain">接口服务器手里有一本超厚的“全球地址簿”。它看到你的 IP 后，在书里翻一翻，发现这个 IP 段是分给“中国北京”的，然后把这个地名告诉你。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block" tabindex="-1"><hr></div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">这套方式稳定吗？</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">结论是：基本稳定，但有三个“小脾气”：</span></strong></span></p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“服务器罢工”风险</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span> <span class="md-plain">我们现在用的是别人的免费接口（ipwhois.app）。如果他们的服务器挂了，或者他们突然想收钱了，你的插件就会“显示失败”。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“网络门槛”风险</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span> <span class="md-plain">这些接口服务器大多在国外。虽然目前能用，但如果哪天你的网络环境（或者防火墙）把这个域名拦住了，插件也抓不到数据。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“查岗上限”风险</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span> <span class="md-plain">免费接口通常有频率限制（比如每小时只能查几十次）。如果你点“刷新”点得太快太勤，它可能会把你暂时封掉，过一会才恢复。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">怎么让它更专业、更稳？</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">如果你追求 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“工业级”</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 的稳定性，通常的做法是：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">备胎计划</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：代码里写 2-3 个不同的接口。第一个失败了，自动去试第二个（比如 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ip-api.com</code></span><span class="md-plain">、</span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>cloudflare</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 等）。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">超时处理</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：如果 5 秒钟没反应，就提示“网络超时”而不是死等。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">目前您的这个插件作为个人自用是非常香的，简单且颜值高！</span></strong></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">嗯，我怕挂了，你再给我加两个备用的地址，如果3秒没有回应就请求备用地址</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">搞定了！我现在为你的插件打造了一套 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“三重保险”方案</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">核心升级点：</span></h3>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">节点轮询 (Failover)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：定义了三个顶级 IP 接口（</span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ipwhois.app</code></span><span class="md-plain">、</span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>freeipapi.com</code></span><span class="md-plain">、</span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>ipapi.co</code></span><span class="md-plain">）。如果第一个挂了，它会自动尝试第二个。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">强制超时 (3秒)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：每个接口只给 3 秒钟响应时间。如果网络卡顿导致 3 秒没出结果，代码会毫不留情地切断当前的尝试，立刻奔向下一个备用节点。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">智能适配</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：不同接口返回的数据“方言”（字段名）不一样，我写了专门的转换逻辑，确保它们都能完美适配你的高颜值 UI。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">权限放行</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：已经在 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">manifest.json</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> 中配置了这三个新域名的合法访问权限。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">您需要做的是：</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">由于更新了 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">manifest.json</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> 和 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.js</span></a></span><span class="md-plain">，请您务必去 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>chrome://extensions/</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 页面，点击插件卡片右下角的 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“圆形刷新按钮”</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 重新加载一下。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">现在，即便其中一个接口罢工，插件也会在毫秒级切换到备用方案，稳定性瞬间拉满！</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 🚀</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">再给我加个功能，在底部右下角可以按钮”查看历史“，把他历史查询的ip存储在本地，点了按钮就能查看</span></p>

<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">*Viewed </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.js</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> *</span></p>

<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">历史记录功能也为您加好了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这次升级包含了一个完整的</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">本地持久化存储系统</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">功能亮点：</span></h3>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">自动记录</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：每次查询成功后，插件会自动把当前的 IP、城市、运营商和查询时间存入 Chrome 本地存储（</span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>chrome.storage.local</code></span><span class="md-plain">）。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">玻璃拟态侧滑面板</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：点击右下角的“历史”按钮，会有一个高级的半透明面板滑出，展示最近 20 条查询记录。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">智能去重</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：如果您的 IP 没有变化，它不会重复记录，避免列表全是一模一样的内容。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">一键清理</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：面板底部提供了“清空历史”按钮，方便重置数据。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">操作演示：</span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">查看</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 点击右下角的小字“历史”。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">关闭</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 点击历史面板右上角的 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>×</code></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">同步</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">: 即使关闭浏览器再打开，历史记录依然会在那里。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">依然是那个重要提醒：</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">请务必去 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>chrome://extensions/</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 页面点击 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“刷新” (圆形箭头)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 按钮，让这份新功能代码生效。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">现在，您的 MyIP Pro 已经不仅仅是一个查询工具，还是一个带记忆的“网络位置足迹仪”了。请试用看看！</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">把左边的时间去掉，然后把历史按钮放到左边去</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">已经按照您的要求完成了调整：</span></p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">移除时间显示</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：删除了左下角实时更新的时间文字。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">位置互换</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：将“历史”按钮移到了左下角，而“已连接”状态保持在右下角，整体视觉更加平衡。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">代码清理</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：同步删除了 </span><span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a><span class="md-plain">popup.js</span></a></span><span class="md-plain"> 中不再需要的定时器和时间更新函数，以此减少插件的资源占用。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">操作建议：</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">请照常在 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>chrome://extensions/</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 页面点击 </span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">“刷新” (圆形箭头)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain"> 按钮，即可看到布局更新。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">现在的界面更加清爽了，左侧是功能入口（历史），右标是运行状态（已连接）。还有其他想微调的地方吗？</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">User Input</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">点击”清空历史“弹窗美化下</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><em><span class="md-plain">Edited relevant file</span></em></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Planner Response</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">没问题，这就为您安排上！我已经把那个枯燥的系统默认弹窗换成了符合您 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>/ui-ux-pro-max</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 审美的</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">高级自定义模态框</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">美化细节：</span></h3>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">磨砂玻璃遮罩</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：背景会瞬间虚化（Blur），让用户的注意力完全集中在弹窗上。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">弹性动画 (Spring Animation)</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：弹窗出现时带有一个极其自然的小缩放反弹效果，看起来非常灵动。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">视觉层级明确</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="*">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">危险警示</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：上方有一个红色的叹号圆圈。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">清空按钮</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：采用亮红色主题，鼠标悬停时会有轻微上浮和发光效果。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">取消按钮</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：保持低调的半透明风格，确保不会抢戏。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">操作方式示例：</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">当您进入历史页面，点击“清空历史”时，它不再是冷冰冰的系统对话框，而是一个优雅滑出的现代 UI 组件。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">提示</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：修改了 JS、HTML 和 CSS 后，依然需要去插件管理页点击那个</span><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">圆形刷新按钮</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">这种细节的提升，确实让整个插件的“高级感”又上了一个台阶。还有其他想优化的吗？</span></p>

</div>
